```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class Socks4ClientEncoder {
        <<final>>
        +Socks4ClientEncoder INSTANCE$
        -byte[] IPv4_DOMAIN_MARKER$
        -Socks4ClientEncoder()
        #encode(ctx, msg, out) void
        -sanitize(fieldName, strValue) CharSequence
    }

    class MessageToByteEncoder~Socks4CommandRequest~ {
        <<abstract>>
        #encode(ctx, msg, out)* void
    }

    class ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter
    class ChannelDuplexHandler
    class ChannelHandlerContext
    class ByteBuf
    class NetUtil
    class EncoderException

    class Socks4CommandRequest {
        <<interface>>
        +type() Socks4CommandType
        +userId() String
        +dstAddr() String
        +dstPort() int
    }

    class Socks4Message {
        <<interface>>
    }

    class SocksMessage {
        <<interface>>
        +version() SocksVersion
    }

    class Socks4CommandType {
        <<class>>
        +CONNECT$ Socks4CommandType
        +BIND$ Socks4CommandType
    }

    class SocksVersion {
        <<enum>>
        +SOCKS4a
        +SOCKS5
    }

    class DefaultSocks4CommandRequest {
        +DefaultSocks4CommandRequest(type, dstAddr, dstPort)
        +DefaultSocks4CommandRequest(type, dstAddr, dstPort, userId)
    }

    class AbstractSocks4Message {
        <<abstract>>
        +version() SocksVersion
    }

    class AbstractSocksMessage {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    class Socks4ProxyHandler {
        <<final>>
    }

    class ProxyHandler {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    %% Encoder hierarchy and collaborators
    Socks4ClientEncoder --|> MessageToByteEncoder~Socks4CommandRequest~
    MessageToByteEncoder~Socks4CommandRequest~ --|> ChannelOutboundHandlerAdapter
    Socks4ClientEncoder ..> Socks4CommandRequest : encodes
    Socks4ClientEncoder ..> ByteBuf : writes to
    Socks4ClientEncoder ..> ChannelHandlerContext : encode param
    Socks4ClientEncoder ..> NetUtil : validates and converts IPv4
    Socks4ClientEncoder ..> EncoderException : throws

    %% Message model consumed by the encoder
    Socks4CommandRequest --|> Socks4Message
    Socks4Message --|> SocksMessage
    Socks4CommandRequest --> Socks4CommandType : type()
    SocksMessage --> SocksVersion : version()
    DefaultSocks4CommandRequest ..|> Socks4CommandRequest
    DefaultSocks4CommandRequest --|> AbstractSocks4Message
    AbstractSocks4Message --|> AbstractSocksMessage
    AbstractSocks4Message ..|> Socks4Message
    AbstractSocksMessage ..|> SocksMessage

    %% Types that use the encoder
    Socks4ProxyHandler --|> ProxyHandler
    ProxyHandler --|> ChannelDuplexHandler
    Socks4ProxyHandler ..> Socks4ClientEncoder : installs INSTANCE
    Socks4ProxyHandler ..> DefaultSocks4CommandRequest : creates
    Socks4ProxyHandler ..> Socks4CommandType : uses CONNECT
```
